examples.chinese: 我是印尼人。妳喜歡台灣嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Yìnní rén. Nǐ xǐhuān Táiwān ma?
examples.english: I am from Indonesia. Do you like Taiwan?

examples.chinese: 我要到郵局去寄信，也要買一些信封。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào dào yóujú qù jì xìn, yě yào mǎi yīxiē xìnfēng.
examples.english: I want to go to the post office to mail a letter, and also buy some envelopes.

examples.chinese: 大學給我一封正式的信，通知我得到獎學金了。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué gěi wǒ yì fēng zhèngshì de xìn, tōngzhī wǒ dédào jiǎngxuéjīn le.
examples.english: The university gave me a formal letter notifying me that I have received a scholarship.

examples.chinese: 老闆收到一封寫滿越南文的信，辦公室沒人看得懂，非找人翻譯不可。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shōudào yī fēng xiě mǎn Yuènánwén de xìn, bàngōngshì méi rén kàn de dǒng, fēi zhǎo rén fānyì bùkě.
examples.english: The boss received a letter written entirely in Vietnamese; no one in the office could understand it, so he absolutely must find someone to translate it.

items.wordHook: a 圭(jade tablet) pressed under an 寸(inch) of wax → one 封(envelope).

examples.chinese: 這個地方到處都有垃圾，又髒又臭，誰要住在這裡呢？
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìfāng dàochù dōu yǒu lājī, yòu zāng yòu chòu, shéi yào zhù zài zhèlǐ ne?
examples.english: This place has garbage everywhere; it's both dirty and smelly—who would want to live here?

examples.chinese: 我忘了倒垃圾，所以家裡很臭。客人來的時候，我們要倒茶請他們喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wàng le dào lājī, suǒyǐ jiālǐ hěn chòu. Kèrén lái de shíhòu, wǒmen yào dào chá qǐng tāmen hē.
examples.english: I forgot to take out the garbage, so the house smells bad. When guests come, we should pour tea and invite them to drink.

examples.chinese: 我家只有爸爸、媽媽和我三口人。臭豆腐太臭了，有的外國人吃了一口就不吃了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zhǐyǒu bàba, māma hé wǒ sān kǒu rén. / Chòu dòufu tài chòu le, yǒude wàiguó rén chī le yì kǒu jiù bù chī le.
examples.english: There are only three people in my family: Dad, Mom, and me. / Stinky tofu is too stinky; some foreigners take one bite and then don't eat any more.

examples.chinese: 小韓一直受不了臭豆腐的味道，昨天終於克服了心理障礙，把臭豆腐吃下去了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán yīzhí shòu bù liǎo chòu dòufu de wèidào, zuótiān zhōngyú kèfú le xīnlǐ zhàng'ài, bǎ chòu dòufu chī xiàqù le.
examples.english: Xiao Han has always been unable to stand the smell of stinky tofu; yesterday he finally overcame his psychological obstacle and ate the stinky tofu.

examples.chinese: 臭豆腐是臺灣有名的小吃，不過味道很獨特，不是每個人都能接受。
examples.pinyin: Chòu dòufu shì Táiwān yǒumíng de xiǎochī, búguò wèidào hěn dútè, bú shì měi ge rén dōu néng jiēshòu.
examples.english: Stinky tofu is a famous snack in Taiwan, but its flavor is very unique; not everyone can accept it.

examples.chinese: 哇！這家小吃店的臭豆腐好辣、好臭哇！怎麼有客人受的了這種味道哇？
examples.pinyin: Wa! Zhè jiā xiǎochī diàn de chòu dòufu hǎo là, hǎo chòu wa! Zěnme yǒu kèrén shòu de liǎo zhè zhǒng wèidào wa?
examples.english: Wow! The stinky tofu at this snack shop is so spicy and smells so stinky! How can any customer stand this smell?

examples.chinese: 這種植物的葉子尖尖的，流出來的汁又臭又黏，觀察時要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù de yèzi jiān jiān de, liú chūlái de zhī yòu chòu yòu nián, guānchá shí yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: The leaves of this plant are pointy, and the sap that flows out is both smelly and sticky; be careful when observing it.

examples.chinese: 除了他以外，我們都會駕駛汽車。 (Prep)。我買了一雙除臭的襪子送給他。 (V)。一百除二的答案是五十。 (Vst)。
examples.pinyin: Chúle tā yǐwài, wǒmen dōu huì jiàshǐ qìchē. (Prep). Wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng chúchòu de wàzi sòng gěi tā. (V). Yībǎi chú èr de dá'àn shì wǔshí. (Vst).
examples.english: Except for him, we all can drive a car. (Prep). I bought a pair of deodorizing socks to give to him. (V). The answer to one hundred divided by two is fifty. (Vst).

examples.chinese: 這次考試的分數沒有我想的那麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì de fēnshù méiyǒu wǒ xiǎng de nàme chà.
examples.english: The score on this exam is not as bad as I thought.

examples.chinese: 這次考試很難，可是大家的分數都不低，好奇怪！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì hěn nán, kěshì dàjiā de fēnshù dōu bù dī, hǎo qíguài!
examples.english: This exam was very hard, but everyone's scores are not low—how strange!

examples.chinese: 這篇作文的錯字太多了，所以分數不高。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piān zuòwén de cuòzì tài duō le, suǒyǐ fēnshù bù gāo.
examples.english: This essay has too many wrong characters, so the score is not high.

examples.chinese: 老師認為這個問題很難，只有一個學生回答得很正確，所以給他加了一些分數。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī rènwéi zhège wèntí hěn nán, zhǐyǒu yí ge xuésheng huídá de hěn zhèngquè, suǒyǐ gěi tā jiā le yìxiē fēnshù.
examples.english: The teacher thought this question was very difficult, and only one student answered very correctly, so he gave him some extra points.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 參加廚師比賽，只要味道部分的分數很高，就有機會得獎。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā chúshī bǐsài, zhǐyào wèidào bùfèn de fēnshù hěn gāo, jiù yǒu jīhuì déjiǎng.
examples.english: In a chef competition, as long as the score for the taste section is high, there is a chance to win a prize.

examples.chinese: 去那座寺廟拜拜的人真多，他們在拜什麼？
examples.pinyin: Qù nà zuò sìmiào bài bài de rén zhēn duō, tāmen zài bài shénme?
examples.english: There are really many people going to that temple to worship—what are they worshipping?

examples.chinese: 拜拜要用的發糕讓老鼠給吃了，讓媽媽非常生氣。
examples.pinyin: Bàibài yào yòng de fāgāo ràng lǎoshǔ gěi chī le, ràng māma fēicháng shēngqì.
examples.english: The fa gao (prosperity cake) to be used for the worship was eaten by mice, which made Mom very angry.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡觀察小動物走來走去的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan guānchá xiǎo dòngwù zǒu lái zǒu qù de yàngzi.
examples.english: I like to observe the way small animals walk back and forth.

examples.chinese: 張老師認真觀察學生們的表現，這樣才能了解他們的心理和學習情況。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng lǎoshī rènzhēn guānchá xuéshengmen de biǎoxiàn, zhèyàng cái néng liǎojiě tāmen de xīnlǐ hé xuéxí qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Teacher Zhang carefully observes the students' performance; only in this way can she understand their psychology and learning situation.

examples.chinese: 這種植物的葉子尖尖的，流出來的汁又臭又黏，觀察時要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù de yèzi jiān jiān de, liú chūlái de zhī yòu chòu yòu nián, guānchá shí yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: The leaves of this plant are pointy, and the sap that flows out is both smelly and sticky; be careful when observing it.

examples.chinese: 麗麗的老公在她生日那天，送了她九十九朵玫瑰花，好浪漫啊！
examples.pinyin: Lìlì de lǎogōng zài tā shēngrì nà tiān, sòng le tā jiǔshíjiǔ duǒ méiguīhuā, hǎo làngmàn a!
examples.english: Lili's husband gave her ninety-nine roses on her birthday; how romantic!

examples.chinese: 老婆：我叫你買豆漿，怎麼買了無糖的，真難喝！ 老公：妳又沒說清楚，怎麼能怪我。
examples.pinyin: Lǎopó: Wǒ jiào nǐ mǎi dòujiāng, zěnme mǎi le wútáng de, zhēn nánhē! Lǎogōng: Nǐ yòu méi shuō qīngchu, zěnme néng guài wǒ.
examples.english: Wife: I told you to buy soy milk; how come you bought the sugar-free kind? It tastes awful! Husband: You didn't say clearly, so how can you blame me?

items.wordHook: A seasoned senior who is 老(old) alongside this 公(public): 老公 means husband.

examples.chinese: 從前有很多生活用具都是用銅做的，像銅杯、銅碗什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Cóngqián yǒu hěn duō shēnghuó yòngjù dōu shì yòng tóng zuò de, xiàng tóng bēi, tóng wǎn shénme de.
examples.english: In the past, many household items were made of copper, like copper cups, copper bowls, and so on.

examples.chinese: 我們打算用擲銅錢的方式，來決定讓誰處理這件事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn yòng zhì tóngqián de fāngshì, lái juédìng ràng shéi chǔlǐ zhè jiàn shì.
examples.english: We plan to use the method of tossing a copper coin to decide who will handle this matter.

examples.chinese: 逃避或許是解決問題的一種方式，但有些問題是你逃不了，不得不解決的。
examples.pinyin: Táobì huòxǔ shì jiějué wèntí de yī zhǒng fāngshì, dàn yǒuxiē wèntí shì nǐ táo bù liǎo, bùdébù jiějué de.
examples.english: Escaping may be one way to solve a problem, but some problems are ones you cannot escape and have no choice but to solve.

examples.chinese: 做事不順利時別只想著逃避，得好好面對才行。
examples.pinyin: Zuòshì bù shùnlì shí bié zhǐ xiǎngzhe táobì, děi hǎohǎo miànduì cái xíng.
examples.english: When things don't go smoothly, don't just think about escaping; you must face them properly.

examples.chinese: 小張出車禍雖然賠了很多錢，不過好在人沒事。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng chū chēhuò suīrán péi le hěn duō qián, bùguò hǎozài rén méi shì.
examples.english: Although Xiao Zhang had a car accident and paid a lot of money, fortunately no one was hurt.

examples.chinese: 每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù. Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing. The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 生病的時候，最好在家休息或是去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Shēngbìng de shíhou, zuìhǎo zài jiā xiūxi huòshì qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: When you're sick, you had better rest at home or go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 生病的時候，最好在家休息或是去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Shēngbìng de shíhou, zuìhǎo zài jiā xiūxi huòshì qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: When you're sick, you had better rest at home or go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽退休後，就在家幫忙照顧孫子和孫女。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma tuìxiū hòu, jiù zài jiā bāngmáng zhàogù sūnzi hé sūnnǚ.
examples.english: After my mother retired, she helps take care of her grandson and granddaughter at home.

items.wordHook: You add (加) your name to the participant (參) list → that's 參加, to participate.
Remembering 古(old) ancestral 人(person) and ancient 事(affair) stories: 古人古事 means ancients and their stories.
Right 今(now), placing a soothing lozenge gently inside the open 口(mouth) lets you 含(hold in the mouth).
a 㠯(mound) lifts a 帀(rotate) banner high, and students gather to the 師(teacher).
Observing the genuine 情(feeling) reality and visible 形(shape) of events: 情形 means situation.
Having 沒(gone) critical 話(talk) left to 說(speak): 沒話說 means beyond words.
美(Měi) + 國(country) → Měi is the old sound for 'America': 美國(the USA).
